init.description: Initialize ALL SDLC protocol files: state files, hooks, git config, CI, PR template, doc templates
init.template:
Create all of the following files. If a file already exists, skip it (do NOT overwrite).

1. protocol/STACK_CONFIG.md — from config.md lines 224-243 with placeholder test/lint/type/build/coverage commands for this project

2. Auto-generate protocol/BENCHMARKS.md — run each STACK_CONFIG command, order most-failing first, use standard ladder: B001 Tests pass (exit0, max 10, low, none), B002 Coverage >=80% (line>=80%, max 5, med, B001), B003 No lint errors (exit0, max 3, low, none), B004 No type errors (exit0, max 3, low, none), B005 Build succeeds (exit0 artifact, max 3, low, none), B006 Complexity <10/func (all<10, max 5, med, none), B007 Security audit (exit0, max 3, med, B001+B005), B008 Public API documented (100%, max 3, low, none), B009 Ladder complete (confirmed, -, low, B001-B008)

3. protocol/STATE.md:
CURRENT_BENCHMARK_ID=B001
CURRENT_BENCHMARK_NAME='All tests pass'
BENCHMARKS_STATUS='B001:IN_PROGRESS B002:PENDING B003:PENDING B004:PENDING B005:PENDING B006:PENDING B007:PENDING B008:PENDING B009:PENDING'
CURRENT_PHASE=ASSESS
CURRENT_CYCLE=1
ACTIVE_TASK_ID=none
LAST_ACTION_RESULT=success
LAST_ERROR=
STARTED_AT=<now ISO 8601>
CYCLES_THIS_BENCHMARK=0
RETRIES_THIS_TASK=0
BOOKMARK_TASK_ID=none
BOOKMARK_FILE=none
BOOKMARK_LINE=0
BOOKMARK_PURPOSE=none
APPROACH_ATTEMPTS=0
PENDING_INTERRUPT=false
HEAD_HASH_BEFORE=

4. protocol/DECISION_LOG.md: | ID | Timestamp | Cycle | Phase | Decision | Rationale | Alternatives | Outcome |

5. protocol/EVALUATION_LOG.md: | ID | Timestamp | Cycle | Benchmark | Result | Evidence | Proximity | Next |

6. protocol/TODO_MAP.md: '# Tasks' then '---' then '## Archive'

7. protocol/ASSUMPTIONS.md: | Timestamp | Assumption | Verified? | Method | Actual | Action |

8. protocol/RETROSPECTIVE_LOG.md: '# Retrospective Log'

9. protocol/STANDUP_LOG.md: '# Standup Log'

10. protocol/RELEASE_PLAN.md: '# Release Plan' with sections Human Priorities (ordered, tagged), Planned Items [ ], Not Now (deferred/rejected), Benchmarks to Target

11. protocol/ROADMAP.md: '# Roadmap' with Long-Term Vision, Milestones table, Guiding Principles, Known Gaps

12. protocol/HUMAN_INTERRUPT.md: 'NONE'

13. protocol/RELEASE_LOG.md: '# Release Log'

14. protocol/CHANGELOG.md: '# Changelog'

15. protocol/adr/README.md: '# Architecture Decision Records' with format Status/Context/Decision/Consequences/Alternatives

16. .githooks/pre-commit (executable, chmod +x): check merge conflicts (<<<<<<), debug artifacts (console.log/debugger/pdb), secrets (sk-live-/AKIA/BEGIN PRIVATE KEY)

17. .githooks/commit-msg (executable): validate Conventional Commits format <type>(<scope>): <desc>

18. .githooks/pre-push (executable): validate branch name <type>/<context>-<desc>

19. .gitconfig with aliases: st=status -sb, ci=commit, co=checkout, br=branch, lg=log --graph --oneline --decorate --all, df=diff, dc=diff --cached, hist=log with pretty format, undo=reset --soft HEAD~1, discard=checkout --, unstage=reset HEAD --

20. .gitignore: .DS_Store Thumbs.db *.log .env .env.local node_modules/ __pycache__/ *.pyc dist/ build/ .next/ .cache/ coverage/ *.tsbuildinfo

21. .gitattributes: *.psd *.bin *.tar.gz *.zip with filter=lfs diff=lfs merge=lfs -text

22. .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md with Description/Type/Related/Testing/Checklist sections

23. .github/workflows/ci.yml with quality job running test/lint/type-check/build

24. protocol/PRD.md: template with Problem Statement, Users/Audience table, Goals, Non-Goals, Success Metrics, Risks

25. protocol/TRD.md: template with Tech Stack table, Architecture, Key Decisions table, Non-Functional Requirements

26. protocol/APP_FLOW.md: template with Entry Points, User Journeys, Error States

27. protocol/API_CONTRACT.md: template with Protocol, Endpoints/Commands table, Backward Compatibility

28. protocol/SCHEMA.md: template with Entities, Relationships, Migrations

29. protocol/adr/ADR-000-example.md: template with Status, Context, Decision, Consequences, Alternatives Considered table

After all files: run 'git config core.hooksPath .githooks'. Log to DECISION_LOG.md: 'SDLC fully initialized.'

sdlc.description: Run autonomous SDLC loop. Add --one to run only the current phase and stop.
sdlc.template:
You are the SDLC loop controller. Lightweight: read STATE.md, dispatch each phase to a `task` sub-agent (fresh context per phase), collect results, update state, loop.

If user added `--one` or said 'single': run exactly ONE phase then stop (skip loop).

=== LOOP ===
1. Read protocol/STATE.md, protocol/STACK_CONFIG.md, protocol/BENCHMARKS.md.
2. Check PENDING_INTERRUPT and HUMAN_INTERRUPT.md per Global Sequence below.
3. Generate unique ID: D{cycle}_{phase}_{isotimestamp}. Check duplicate before write.
4. Log dispatch to DECISION_LOG.md.
5. Read line counts of protocol/DECISION_LOG.md and protocol/EVALUATION_LOG.md. If either >500 lines: spawn a task sub-agent to consolidate (summarize last 20 cycles into one entry each, write 'Consolidated logs for cycles {range}').
6. Spawn a `task` sub-agent with the relevant phase instructions below to execute the current phase. Sub-agent returns: what happened, errors, new STATE.md content.
7. Read result. Update STATE.md with new CURRENT_PHASE.
8. Write outcome to DECISION_LOG.md.
9. If --one mode: stop now and report.
10. If new CURRENT_PHASE differs from previous: LOOP back to step 1.
11. STOP looping when: RELEASE_PLANNING (present summary, wait for human), COMPLETE (all achieved), or blocking error.

=== GLOBAL SEQUENCE ===
1. PENDING_INTERRUPT=true in STATE.md → read HUMAN_INTERRUPT.md, archive incomplete tasks to TODO_MAP.md archive, append timestamped sub-entry to STANDUP_LOG.md under current standup, clear both files (write 'NONE'), set CURRENT_PHASE=PLAN, skip.
2. Read HUMAN_INTERRUPT.md. Has content?
   - Phase is RELEASE/RETROSPECT/RELEASE_PLANNING → set PENDING_INTERRUPT=true, do NOT clear file, proceed.
   - All others → process now: log decision, archive tasks, append standup sub-entry, clear both files, CURRENT_PHASE=PLAN, skip.
3. Generate D{cycle}_{phase}_{isotimestamp}. Check duplicate.
4. Log intended action before dispatching.

=== RULES (pass to sub-agent) ===
1. Plan before code. 2. Log assumptions to ASSUMPTIONS.md before acting. 3. Only use project deps. 4. Never commit failing test/type/lint. 5. YAGNI. 6. Never skip self-check. 7. Document deviations. 8. One responsibility per function. 9. Commit after every verified change. 10. Human input overrides.

=== ANTI-HALLUCINATION ===
1. Verify lib signatures. 2. Never guess signatures. 3. Run commands, NEVER simulate. 4. Log every assumption. >5 unverified→STOP. 5. Prefer builtins>libs, existing>new, simple>clever. 6. Read STATE.md before every action. Write after.

=== SUB-AGENT INSTRUCTIONS ===

-- ASSESS --
Read STATE.md, STACK_CONFIG.md, BENCHMARKS.md. Confirm CURRENT_PHASE=ASSESS. Map benchmark Measurement to command. Pre-flight: `which` each. Missing→log+skip. test-command/build-command missing→COMPLETE+fail+STOP. Run measurement, capture output. Evaluate: all criteria→MET, any fail→NOT_MET. Proximity: test=passing/total, coverage=current/target, lint=1-(errors/baseline), complexity=func_below_threshold/total, boolean='No numeric proximity'. Risk=high→query external signals. Write EVALUATION_LOG.md: | E{cycle}_{benchmark}_{isotimestamp} | {ts} | {cycle} | {ID} | {MET/NOT_MET} | {output} | {proximity} | {next} |. MET→CURRENT_PHASE=RELEASE, LAST_ACTION_RESULT=benchmark_met. NOT_MET→CURRENT_PHASE=PLAN, CYCLES_THIS_BENCHMARK+=1. CYCLES>Max→COMPLETE+fail+STOP. 3 consecutive same proximity→log stagnation. Return: result, new STATE.md content.

-- PLAN --
Read STATE.md, STACK_CONFIG.md, BENCHMARKS.md, EVALUATION_LOG.md (latest), RETROSPECTIVE_LOG.md (last 2), STANDUP_LOG.md (latest), RELEASE_PLAN.md, ROADMAP.md. Step 0: READ STANDUP_LOG.md+RELEASE_PLAN.md. Conflict with benchmark→log+prioritize human+tag '(human request—STANDUP-{N})'. Step 1: gap analysis—classify failures (ASSERTION/COMPILE/TIMEOUT/RUNTIME), coverage lines by module, lint/type by file. 3 stagnant cycles→skip to step 6. Step 2: design changes for benchmark, apply retro learnings. Step 3: split if >3 files, test+impl, new lib, schema+logic, 'and'/'then'. Step 4: format [ ] T{ID}—{name} with file/what/benchmark/depends/risk/timebox/type. feature→test fails before. fix→regression first. refactor→passes before+after. config→verification script. docs→no test. Step 5: order by depends, max 10. depends:none different files→parallel candidates. Step 6: stagnation (CYCLES>ceil(max/2) OR 3 cycles no improvement)→2-3 approaches (effort/probability/risk), pick best ratio, APPROACH_ATTEMPTS+=1. >2 failed→COMPLETE+fail+STOP. Step 7: write TODO_MAP.md, DECISION_LOG.md. STATE.md: CURRENT_PHASE=IMPLEMENT, ACTIVE_TASK_ID=first, RETRIES_THIS_TASK=0. Create design docs from protocol/ templates if missing. Return: TODO_MAP.md content, new STATE.md.

-- IMPLEMENT --
Read STATE.md, STACK_CONFIG.md, TODO_MAP.md, ASSUMPTIONS.md. Bookmark match→continue from BOOKMARK_FILE:LINE. Else fresh start. Select: ACTIVE_TASK_ID or first [ ]. PARALLEL if 'PARALLEL: T{ID},T{ID}' (all depends:none, diff files, same type; implement both no-commit, verify all, pass→commit both, fail→git checkout -- .→sequential). Dependency not [x]→do first. Impact: search imports/usages, log dependents, test after. Test first: feature/fix→fails before, refactor→passes before+after, config→script fails before, docs→skip. Implement minimum, only project deps. Log assumptions before acting. HEAD_HASH_BEFORE=$(git rev-parse HEAD). Store in STATE.md. Verify: test→type→lint. All pass→commit with 'git add -A && git commit -m "{type}(T{ID}): {summary}"' (type→feat/fix/refactor/chore/docs). Fail→git stash→run→git stash pop. Same failure→pre-existing, log. NEW: RETRIES_THIS_TASK+=1. <MAX_RETRIES→fix+re-verify. >=MAX_RETRIES→git reset --hard $HEAD_HASH_BEFORE, split into 2 subtasks, original→[x] abandoned. Test dependents. Set bookmark. More [ ]→next task loop. All [x]→ACTIVE_TASK_ID=none, CURRENT_PHASE=VERIFY. Return: tasks completed, new STATE.md.

-- VERIFY --
Read STATE.md, STACK_CONFIG.md. `which` each command. Missing→skip+log. test-command missing→COMPLETE+fail+STOP. Run: test (exit0), type-check (exit0 if avail), lint (exit0 if avail), build (exit0 if avail). Every 5th cycle: run dependency-audit-command. Vulns→add docs task (non-blocking). Failure→root cause→new task→CURRENT_PHASE=IMPLEMENT, ACTIVE_TASK_ID=new task. All pass→DECISION_LOG 'verification passed', CURRENT_PHASE=ASSESS. Return: results, new STATE.md.

-- RELEASE --
Read STATE.md, STACK_CONFIG.md, BENCHMARKS.md, EVALUATION_LOG.md (latest), DECISION_LOG.md (since last release), RELEASE_LOG.md (latest). Confirm RELEASE. Determine version from scheme+RELEASE_LOG.md (semver). Risk=high→after tag, run previous benchmark measurement. Regression→git revert HEAD, git tag -d v{version}, log, CURRENT_PHASE=PLAN, fix task, return. Compile DECISION_LOG+EVALUATION_LOG evidence. Generate release notes. Append RELEASE_LOG.md. Prepend CHANGELOG.md. git add protocol/RELEASE_LOG.md CHANGELOG.md && git commit -m 'release: v{version}—benchmark {ID} achieved' && git tag -a v{version} -m 'release: v{version}—benchmark {ID} achieved'. STATE.md: mark benchmark ACHIEVED in BENCHMARKS_STATUS, CURRENT_PHASE=RETROSPECT. Return: version, new STATE.md.

-- RETROSPECT --
Read STATE.md, DECISION_LOG.md (this cycle), EVALUATION_LOG.md (this cycle), TODO_MAP.md (cycle tasks), RETROSPECTIVE_LOG.md (previous). Confirm RETROSPECT. Score = (completed/planned)*0.5 + (1-rework_ratio)*0.3 + (1-scope_creep)*0.2. Target >0.7. Identify common failure, root cause, failure_impl_time_ratio. Adapt timebox: avg_actual/timebox <0.5→-1h (min 1), >1.5→+1h (max 8). Define 1-3 improvements (planning/execution/verification). Write RETROSPECTIVE_LOG.md entry with Metrics/Patterns/Adaptive Timebox/Improvements. Archive TODO: move completed tasks below '---' as [x] T{ID}—{name} (completed/interrupted in cycle {N}) with what/result/mid_cycle. STATE.md: CURRENT_PHASE=RELEASE_PLANNING. Return: score, new STATE.md.

-- RELEASE_PLANNING --
Read STATE.md, STACK_CONFIG.md, BENCHMARKS.md, RELEASE_LOG.md, RETROSPECTIVE_LOG.md, STANDUP_LOG.md (previous), ROADMAP.md. Check RELEASE_PLANNING_TIMEOUT_HOURS from STACK_CONFIG.md: if timeout elapsed since STATE.md STARTED_AT, skip human prompt, use last standup direction or ROADMAP.md, log timeout. Present to user: Last release v{version}, benchmark {ID} achieved, cycle cost {N}tasks/{N}h, retro score {score}, ladder status. Ask: (1) What to prioritize? (2) Ladder changes? (3) Feedback? If ambiguous→ask one clarifying question. Capture input verbatim. Write STANDUP-{N} with: Version Discussed, What Was Achieved, Discussion Points, Blockers, Human Input (verbatim), Decisions table, Action Items table, Next Steps. Write/overwrite RELEASE_PLAN.md: Human Priorities (ordered, tagged STANDUP-{N}), Planned Items [ ], Not Now (deferred/rejected), Benchmarks to Target. Update ROADMAP.md if long-term direction given. Write DECISION_LOG.md. STATE.md: CURRENT_PHASE=ADVANCE. Return: STANDUP-{N}, new STATE.md.

-- ADVANCE --
Read STATE.md, BENCHMARKS.md, RELEASE_PLAN.md. Confirm ADVANCE. Mark current benchmark **[ACHIEVED]** in BENCHMARKS.md. Check RELEASE_PLAN.md for human priority→if specific benchmark, target that; if ladder change, update; if general, dependency scan. Find next unachieved benchmark where ALL deps are ACHIEVED. Multiple depends:none→lowest ID. If MULTIPLE depends:none benchmarks qualify: set STATE.md ACTIVE_TASK_ID='PARALLEL: B{id1},B{id2}' and spawn concurrent task sub-agents for each (they share no files). Next exists→STATE.md: CURRENT_BENCHMARK_ID/NAME={next}, CURRENT_PHASE=ASSESS, CURRENT_CYCLE+=1, CYCLES_THIS_BENCHMARK=0, APPROACH_ATTEMPTS=0, ACTIVE_TASK_ID=none. No next→CURRENT_PHASE=COMPLETE. Write BENCHMARKS.md, DECISION_LOG.md. Return: new STATE.md.

-- COMPLETE --
Confirm all benchmarks ACHIEVED. Present: v{version}, {N} cycles, {N} benchmarks, {N} releases. Ask: (1) New ladder (2) Maintenance (3) Archive (4) Other. Write FINAL-STANDUP to STANDUP_LOG.md. New ladder→write new BENCHMARKS.md, reset STATE (keep ROADMAP.md+RELEASE_LOG.md, clear TODO/DECISION/EVALUATION/PENDING_INTERRUPT, CYCLE=0, PHASE=ASSESS). Archive→final tag, COMPLETE. Other→document. Manual ladder→'New ladder'. Return: decision, done.

=== CROSS-CUTTING ===
Hotfix: HUMAN writes HUMAN_INTERRUPT.md. git checkout v{prod} -b hotfix/v{version}-{desc}. Fix per IMPLEMENT rules. Bump PATCH. Full verify. git tag + merge --no-ff to main+develop. Delete branch. Log.
Patch: release/v{major}.{minor}.{patch+1} from develop. Cherry-pick fixes only. Update version+CHANGELOG. Merge main (--no-ff), tag, backport to develop.
Rollback: git revert HEAD --no-edit, git tag -d v{broken}, git push origin :v{broken}, git push origin main. Log trigger. Create fix task. Mark FAILED.
Cherry-pick: ALLOWED: release freeze→release/*, hotfix→develop, security→security. FORBIDDEN: features, bypass pipeline. Log every cherry-pick (source hash, target, why).
Cross-session: Resumed via /resume command.
Error: Transient→retry. Permanent→fix+retry. Unknown→investigate task. Stall→STOP+log. Approach exhausted→STOP.
Feature flags: {PROJECT}_{FEATURE}. Cleanup after full release. Every flag→cleanup task in TODO.
Dependency updates: Review every 4 weeks. Patch→update+test. Minor→full suite. Major→task. Security→48h.

=== GIT CONVENTIONS ===
Branch: <type>/<context>-<kebab-case-description> (max 72 chars). Types: feature/fix/hotfix/release/chore/docs/refactor/perf/security/experiment.
Commit: <type>(<scope>): <desc> (types: feat/fix/refactor/perf/chore/docs/style/test/build/ci/security/release).
Tag: v<major>.<minor>.<patch>[-<pre-release>.<N>] (annotated: git tag -a v{N} -m '...').
Merge: single-commit→--ff, multi→--squash or --no-ff, release/hotfix→--no-ff. Staging→canary→main: rebase+FF.
Protection: main/canary: deny push/force, PR+2+all CI. develop: PR+1+test+lint+type. Others: allowed, no PR.

=== REPORT ===
Tell user which phases ran, key results, and new CURRENT_PHASE. If at RELEASE_PLANNING: present standup questions. If COMPLETE: final summary with choices. If --one: report single phase result and stop.

resume.description: Cross-session recovery — reads all protocol files in order, checks git status, resumes at CURRENT_PHASE
resume.template:
Execute cross-session recovery per SDLC protocol Appendix E:

1. Read protocol/STATE.md → identify CURRENT_PHASE, CURRENT_CYCLE, PENDING_INTERRUPT
2. Read protocol/STACK_CONFIG.md → project commands
3. Read protocol/DECISION_LOG.md (last 5 entries) → recent context
4. Read protocol/EVALUATION_LOG.md (last entry) → last benchmark evaluation
5. Read protocol/RELEASE_LOG.md (latest) → release history
6. Read protocol/RETROSPECTIVE_LOG.md (latest) → last retrospective
7. Read protocol/STANDUP_LOG.md (latest) → last human direction
8. Read protocol/RELEASE_PLAN.md → human priorities
9. Read protocol/ROADMAP.md → long-term vision
10. Read protocol/HUMAN_INTERRUPT.md → pending mid-cycle redirect
11. Read protocol/BENCHMARKS.md → current benchmark ladder
12. Read protocol/ASSUMPTIONS.md → verified assumptions
13. Read protocol/TODO_MAP.md → remaining tasks
14. Run `git status --short`. If dirty working tree:
    - If CURRENT_PHASE is IMPLEMENT or VERIFY: `git stash push -m 'uncommitted work from session recovery'`, log in DECISION_LOG.md.
    - If CURRENT_PHASE is RELEASE or later: log warning, ask human to handle manually.
15. If PENDING_INTERRUPT=true: process the interrupt now (read HUMAN_INTERRUPT.md, archive tasks, append standup sub-entry, clear files, set CURRENT_PHASE=PLAN).
16. If CURRENT_PHASE=RELEASE_PLANNING: present standup summary fresh (session may not have completed discussion).
17. Present full recovery summary: current benchmark, phase, cycle, open tasks, recent decisions, pending interrupt status.
18. Suggest: 'Run /sdlc to resume the loop.'

health.description: Validate protocol state file consistency — checks STATE.md, BENCHMARKS.md, TODO_MAP.md, DECISION_LOG.md for errors
health.template:
Validate all protocol files for consistency:

1. Read protocol/STATE.md. Check all required fields exist: CURRENT_BENCHMARK_ID, CURRENT_BENCHMARK_NAME, BENCHMARKS_STATUS, CURRENT_PHASE (must be one of: ASSESS/PLAN/IMPLEMENT/VERIFY/RELEASE/RETROSPECT/RELEASE_PLANNING/ADVANCE/COMPLETE), CURRENT_CYCLE, ACTIVE_TASK_ID, LAST_ACTION_RESULT, CYCLES_THIS_BENCHMARK, RETRIES_THIS_TASK, APPROACH_ATTEMPTS, PENDING_INTERRUPT. Report missing or invalid fields.

2. Read protocol/BENCHMARKS.md. Parse each benchmark entry (B001-B009). Check: each has type, measurement, passing criteria, max cycles, risk, depends. Verify BENCHMARKS_STATUS in STATE.md matches what's in BENCHMARKS.md (ACHIEVED/PENDING/IN_PROGRESS). Flag benchmarks with [ACHIEVED] mark but pending in STATE, or vice versa.

3. Read protocol/STACK_CONFIG.md. Check it has: Project type, Language, Commands table, Version scheme, Adaptive config. Flag missing fields.

4. Read protocol/TODO_MAP.md. Parse all [ ] tasks. For each: check T{ID} is unique, check benchmark field references a real B{ID} from BENCHMARKS.md, check depends field references a real T{ID} or 'none', check type is one of feature/fix/refactor/config/docs. Flag invalid tasks.

5. Read protocol/DECISION_LOG.md. Check ID format (D{cycle}_{phase}_{isotimestamp}). Check for duplicate IDs. Count total entries. Report if >500 (needs consolidation).

6. Read protocol/EVALUATION_LOG.md. Check ID format (E{cycle}_{benchmark}_{isotimestamp}). Count entries. Report if >500.

7. Read protocol/ASSUMPTIONS.md. Count unverified entries (Verified?=NO or empty). If >5: report as CRITICAL WARNING.

8. Read protocol/HUMAN_INTERRUPT.md. If not 'NONE': report pending interrupt.

9. Check protocol/adr/ files exist. Report count.

10. Check .githooks/ files exist and are executable. Report missing hooks.

Present a health report table:
| Check | Status (PASS/FAIL/WARN) | Detail |
Include a summary: PASS count, FAIL count, WARN count. If any FAIL: suggest fixes. If all PASS: confirm system is healthy.

status.template:
Read protocol/STATE.md, protocol/BENCHMARKS.md, protocol/TODO_MAP.md, protocol/DECISION_LOG.md (last 5), protocol/ASSUMPTIONS.md, protocol/HUMAN_INTERRUPT.md. Present:
- Current benchmark: {ID} — {name}
- Current phase: {phase}
- Cycle: {cycle} ({cycles_this_benchmark} on this benchmark)
- Active task: {task_id}
- Benchmarks: table of all with status (ACHIEVED/IN_PROGRESS/PENDING) and depends
- Open tasks: count and list first 3
- Last 5 decisions: summary table
- Unverified assumptions: count (WARNING if >5)
- Pending interrupt: yes/no
Suggested next action based on CURRENT_PHASE.
